title: Back to the Future: Rethinking EDA Infrastructure for Agentic Systems in Chip Design Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.06790v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The unprecedented computational scale of modern artificial intelligence depends on complex, multi-billion-transistor Systems-on-Chip, yet the workflows that verify these chips remain stubbornly manual. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have made rapid inroads into Electronic Design Automation (EDA), approximately 74.6% of existing studies target static Register-Transfer Level (RTL) code generation, leaving post-simulation verification and interactive waveform debugging largely untouched. We introduce Back-to-the-Future (BTTF), an end-to-end agentic framework that closes this infrastructural gap. BTTF distills massive, unstructured simulation dumps into a normalized relational SQLite database and couples it with a collaborative multi-agent orchestration engine that translates natural-language verification queries into schema-aware SQL while correlating signal anomalies with versioned RTL repositories. translated_title: 回到未来：重新思考芯片设计验证中面向智能体系统的EDA基础设施
translated_abstract: 现代人工智能前所未有的计算规模依赖于复杂的多亿晶体管片上系统，然而验证这些芯片的工作流程仍然顽固地依赖手工操作。尽管大语言模型（LLM）已经迅速进入电子设计自动化（EDA）领域，但现有研究中约74.6%专注于静态的寄存器传输级（RTL）代码生成，而仿真后的验证和交互式波形调试领域基本未被触及。我们提出了Back-to-the-Future（BTTF），一个端到端的智能体框架，用以弥补这一基础设施上的空白。BTTF将海量、非结构化的仿真转储数据提炼为规范化的关系型SQLite数据库，并将其与协作式多智能体编排引擎相结合，该引擎能够将自然语言验证查询转换为具备模式感知能力的SQL，同时将信号异常与版本化的RTL代码库进行关联。在一个包含150个查询的基准测试中……
tldr: 提出了端到端智能体框架BTTF，通过将海量仿真数据规范化为SQLite数据库并结合多智能体编排引擎，将自然语言验证查询转化为模式感知的SQL并关联信号异常与版本化RTL代码库，填补了LLM在EDA中仅应用于静态RTL代码生成、而仿真后验证与波形调试长期空白的缺口。
en_tdlr: BTTF is an end-to-end agentic framework that distills massive simulation dumps into a normalized SQLite database and couples it with a multi-agent orchestration engine, translating natural-language verification queries into schema-aware SQL while correlating signal anomalies with versioned RTL repositories, thereby closing the gap in post-simulation verification and waveform debugging left by LLM studies focused on static RTL code generation.
